phase3.gigsHelp.en: Short local jobs. Check parole conditions with your officer. Phone numbers are never shown.
phase3.gigsHelp.draft: Asa eo an-toerana fohy. Jereo amin'ny mpitandro ny filaminana ny fepetra momba ny fialantsiny. Tsy aseho velively ny nomeraon-telefaona.

phase3.housingHelp.en: Savings goals plus a housing-readiness plan. Groundwork does not provide housing and does not partner with providers. For local help, call 211.
phase3.housingHelp.draft: Tanjona fitehirizana miampy drafitra fanomanana trano. Groundwork dia tsy manome trano ary tsy miara-miasa amin'ny mpamatsy. Raha mila fanampiana eo an-toerana, antsoy ny 211.

phase3.paidNote.en: Paid plan. No price has been set yet.
phase3.paidNote.draft: Drafitra fandoavam-bola. Tsy mbola napetraka ny vidiny.

reentry.call211.draft: Fiantsoana 211 ho an'ny loharanon-karena eo an-toerana

reentry.crisisStep.en: Save these numbers now. You can also tap Need help now at the top of any screen.
reentry.crisisStep.draft: Azonao atao koa ny manindry Mila fanampiana izao eo an-tampon'ny efijery rehetra.

reentry.steps.step11.draft: Tehirizo ao amin'ny findainao ny 988 sy 911

reentry.steps.step14.en: Put every court date and check-in on a calendar
reentry.steps.step14.draft: Ataovy ao amin'ny kalandrie ny datin'ny fitsarana rehetra

reentry.steps.step17.en: Check your fines, fees and restitution
reentry.steps.step17.draft: Jereo ny sazy, ny sarany ary ny famerenam-bola

reentry.steps.step19.en: Enroll in Medicaid, and SNAP if you need it
reentry.steps.step19.draft: Misoratra anarana amin'ny Medicaid, ary SNAP raha mila izany ianao

reentry.steps.step7.en: Find a safe place to stay (call 211 or local housing resources)
reentry.steps.step7.draft: Mitadiava toerana azo antoka hijanonana (antso 211 na loharanom-bolan'ny trano fonenana eo an-toerana)

reentry.steps.step8.en: Find food for this week (call 211 or a local food pantry)
reentry.steps.step8.draft: Mitadiava sakafo ho an'ity herinandro ity (antsoy ny 211 na ny fivarotana sakafo eo an-toerana)

safety.relapseDraft.en: Draft — for review. Calm first steps for the first 24 hours after a slip will appear here once reviewed. You are not alone.
safety.relapseDraft.draft: Ny drafitra  —  ho an'ny famerenana. Ny dingana voalohany milamina mandritra ny 24 ora voalohany aorian'ny fisintonana dia hiseho eto rehefa averina jerena. Tsy irery ianao.

safety.vaultHelp.draft: Voahidy ny antontan-taratasinao. Endri-javatra amin'ny drafitra karama; tsy mbola napetraka ny vidiny.

support.resourcesNote.en: Legal aid, treatment and transit. This directory does not cover food or housing.

wellbeing.roughHelp.en: You are not alone. The crisis button above is always here — call or text 988, or 911 in an emergency.
wellbeing.roughHelp.draft: Tsy irery ianao. Ny bokotra krizy etsy ambony dia eto foana  —  miantso na mandefa hafatra 988, na 911 amin'ny toe-javatra maika.

work.paroleNote.en: Check your parole or probation conditions with your officer before applying.
